execution_steps: 1. Confirmed via grep that no existing code inspects Resource Data module structure at all -- same starting point as the Metadata module before the immediately preceding tick.

2. Read the pinned XLIFF 2.1 Resource Data module XSD directly (.local/format-contracts/acquired/xliff/src-xlf-002.bin, schemas/resource_data.xsd): res:resourceData is a sequence of res:resourceItemRef (0..unbounded) and res:resourceItem (0..unbounded); res:resourceItem sequences res:source (0..1), res:target (0..1), res:reference (0..unbounded); res:source/res:target both declare href use="optional"; res:reference declares href use="required".

3. Added _resource_data_module_diagnostics() to validator.py: scoped to only extensions whose tag matches the Resource Data module's own qname, re-parses the extension's raw XML (same pattern as _metadata_module_diagnostics), walks every res:reference element at any nesting depth via ElementTree's recursive iter(), and flags any missing its href attribute. Deliberately does not assert anything about source/target's href, since it is genuinely optional and there is nothing to enforce about an optional attribute.

4. Wired the new check alongside the existing _extension_well_formed()/_metadata_module_diagnostics() checks at all 3 call sites where extensions are walked: segment extensions, file/group-nested extensions, root-level extensions.

5. Checked the existing Resource Data module fixture (test_obligation_module_coverage.py) before writing anything: it uses a bare resourceItemRef with no res:reference element at all, so the new check cannot false-positive on it (zero reference elements to inspect).

6. Verified interactively before writing formal tests: a reference with href validates cleanly; a reference with no href is a violation; source/target with no href validate cleanly (proving the optional half is correctly NOT enforced); a non-Resource-Data-namespaced extension is untouched; a mix of resourceItems with one bad reference among several good ones is still correctly flagged -- all 5 cases correct on the first attempt.
7. Ran the full pre-existing xliff suite (415 tests, zero new fixtures) against the new check to look for false positives before writing a single new test -- all 415 passed unchanged.
8. Wrote 6 formal tests, all passing on the first attempt.

9. Ran ruff (clean), the full xliff suite (421 passed, was 415, +6), and the full 6-format regression (3334 passed, was 3328, +6; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.

10. Ran skills-first governance: resolve -> add-python-api (COMPOSE_EXISTING_SKILLS), manifest create --write (sfx-6fd6f6219280f067, confirmed as the actually-persisted manifest via ls -t .local/skills-first/manifests/), hand-written receipt YAML, closeout --close -> CLOSE_OK.
